label: Late-episode dips at D1 after reaching S2 (esp. a1->S2 rare), and a1 choices
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 3.0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 3.0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 3.0) ;; (phase == GO) * (choice > 0) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 3.0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (choice > 0)
explanation: Raw reset gate r13 sits near 1 (mean 0.994) and drops mostly in the last ~10 trials of the episode (timing alone R^2 0.54). Beyond timing, the drops depend on history, and they grow steeply toward the episode end (modelled as exp((ep_trial-99)/3)). At D1 it falls after the previous trial reached S2, with the largest drop after the rare a1->S2 transition. Even early in the episode there is a small constant dip at D1 after a1->S2. Previous reward adds little (scored, about 0.01 extra). At GO it is lower when the policy favours a1 (choice > 0), and at D2 it is lower after choosing a1, both mostly late in the episode. Observed-only terms (policy logit at GO instead of the future action) score as well as using the upcoming action. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.39 (dev 0.37). This beats the additive all ceiling (0.13) because the history effects interact with the end-of-episode ramp. The trial before and the hidden good state add almost nothing.
